ns2:course.label: Asian American Cultures
ns2:course.description: (ANTH 184) Surveys the heterogeneity of contemporary Asian American communities. Explores the core concepts of "culture" and "social organization" through the variety of experiences in the family, churches, business establishments, schools, and other public institutions. Same as AAS 184, and SOC 124.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: UIUC Social Sciences, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
